spawn_candidates.title: Provide a CI-native exact-snapshot frontier-pressure execution lane
spawn_candidates.reason: The compiler is filesystem-based and the disposable chat shell can read GitHub state but cannot materialize a complete exact checkout. A bounded CI/read-only execution lane can run on repository bytes and persist the machine-readable snapshot without changing Current/Served authority.
